meta.name: antinet-security-scan
meta.description: 信息安全分析师与软件开发工程师在搭建文档处理流水线时，当需要拦截违规文件或外部URL，请挂载此技能作为强制前置安检，自动输出 pass/reject 判定与详细合规扫描报告，一键守住零信任安全底线。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动拦截文档流水线中的违规文件与外部URL，输出合规扫描报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在搭建文档处理流水线，需要拦截违规文件或外部URL以保障安全。
copy.tagline_en: Block bad files and URLs in document pipelines and output compliance reports.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build document pipelines and need to block bad files or URLs for security.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在文件或外部 URL 进入流水线前先做合规安检，输出 pass 或 reject 判定，并附上命中黑名单项、许可状态、风险等级的扫描报告和 trace_id 留痕。
howto.when: 当文件或外部 URL 要进入文档处理流水线、需要先拦截违规内容时，它作为第一道闸门被调用把关。

say.text: 帮我扫描这个 PDF 文件是否合规
say.note: 返回 pass 或 reject 与扫描报告

say.text: 检查这个 URL 的域名是否在违规黑名单里
say.note: 先解析域名再比对黑名单

say.text: 用指定的 policy_ref 扫描这份文档
say.note: 按自定义合规规则集出判定

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a compliance check on a file or external URL before it enters the pipeline, outputting a pass or reject verdict with a scan report (blacklist hits, license status, risk level) and a trace_id.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a file or external URL needs to enter a document pipeline and违规 content must be blocked first; it acts as the first gate.

say_en.text: Scan this PDF file for compliance
say_en.note: Returns a pass/reject verdict plus a report

say_en.text: Check whether this URL's domain is on the violation blacklist
say_en.note: Domain is resolved then matched against the blacklist

say_en.text: Scan this document using the given policy_ref
say_en.note: Uses your custom compliance ruleset for the verdict
